== Acquisition ==
This skill can be temporarily acquired by [[Primary profession|primary]] [[Mesmer]]s by talking to [[Kuunavang]] in [[Raisu Palace]], [[Imperial Sanctum]] or [[Raisu Palace (explorable area)]].

== Notes ==
* The skill descriptions omit that this skill can only be recharged when gaining a [[Morale Boost]].
* Consider using in synergy with [[Echo]] or [[Arcane Echo]].
* This skill seems to have a similar abilities to [[Mantra of Celerity]], an elite Fast Casting skill removed before Prophecies was released.
